children: Overview
Denmark IT solutions provider's Q3 revenue declined 5.1% yr/yr, impacted by strategic choices and project delays
Adjusted EBIT margin fell to 5.4% from 8.2% a year earlier
Company narrowed full-year 2026 revenue outlook to -1% to -6% constant currency growth
Outlook
NNIT now sees 2026 constant currency revenue growth at -1% to -6%
NNIT maintains 2026 EBIT margin excl. special items at 4-7%
NNIT expects 2026 special items below DKK 83m
Result Drivers
STRATEGIC CHOICES - Co said revenue decline was largely due to deliberate strategic choices, greater selectiveness in contract onboarding and focus on core products
PROJECT DELAYS - Customer hesitation in Europe led to project delays and cancellations
COST REDUCTION - Progress on transformation and cost-reduction initiatives partly offset profitability impact from revenue decline
